actions.reason: C0001 has coherent adjusted RNA evidence of a metabolic-down program, no set-specific technical confounder, and positive fused boundaries to all other sets. Structure is weakly cohesive (near-zero silhouettes) but no reproducible internal subdivision or insufficient separation is indicated, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation with residual structural uncertainty.

C0002 shows adjusted-significant PBRM1 and DST mutation enrichment with a coherent PBRM1-mutant profile, no set-specific technical confounder, and positive boundaries. RNA support is weak and cohesion is low, but no structural revision is positively supported, so it is retained with residual uncertainty.

C0003 has concordant strong immune/inflammatory RNA up-regulation and adjusted BAP1 enrichment, no set-specific technical confounder, and positive boundaries. Cohesion is modest and ct/wsi silhouettes are negative, but no reproducible subdivision or merge is indicated, so it is retained with residual uncertainty.

C0004 has a coherent adjusted VHL-high/PBRM1-low mutation pattern with no set-specific technical confounder and positive boundaries. The identity is essentially wxs-defined with absent RNA support, but no structural revision is positively supported, so it is retained with residual uncertainty.

C0005 has strong adjusted PBRM1 enrichment with a consistent VHL trend and modest multimodal cohesion. Set-specific technical associations with tissue source site and scanner model are present, so a technical contribution cannot be excluded; nevertheless the mutation signal is coherent and no structural revision is supported, so it is retained with this caveat.

C0006 has strong adjusted MUC16 enrichment with a directionally consistent VHL/PBRM1 depletion trend and no set-specific technical confounder. RNA support is absent and cohesion is weak, but no reproducible subdivision or merge is indicated, so it is retained with residual uncertainty.

C0007 has a strong coherent adjusted VHL/PBRM1-depleted mutation pattern with positive boundaries. A set-specific scanner-model association is present, so a technical contribution cannot be excluded; the identity is essentially wxs-defined, but no structural revision is supported, so it is retained with this caveat.
